dependency_diff: Upstream baseline/candidate descriptors and dependency qualifications are unchanged; U6 uses separate Dockerfile.u6 and Dockerfile.u6-candidate.
Candidate remains the official 0.1.2rc1 matching wheel bundled executable, baseline remains 0.1.1rc1; no fork, native-package substitution or main-runtime replacement.
limitations: This is independent U6 build-bound release readiness, not production deployment, default promotion, U7 completion or T40 observation. Production baseline was observed stopped/unhealthy and requires authorized restoration.

Model runs counts eight final-artifact logical journeys including the rejected G2 sample, not provider calls or a paired success-rate benchmark. Historical U5 repeated samples remain historical; U6 affected scenarios were refreshed against exact retained artifacts.

The original G2 answer/count-only automated PASS was semantically rejected. A distinct retest supplied only validated synthetic object context after the unchanged fixed prompt and proved the exact summary read plus result analysis.
OpenCode protocol routes remain deterministic coverage only; no credentialed OpenCode qualification is claimed.
G3 needed one bounded continuation retry; browser review deliberately delayed G6 approval. These latencies are not paired performance improvement evidence.
Earlier failed CI, diagnostic and artifact-handoff attempts and withdrawn U5 isolation evidence remain unchanged; no real Hub mutation or publication occurred during U6.
Shared filesystem locking is a single-host gate, not a multi-host/NFS admission system. Synthetic temporary backups are not persistent production backups.
Image identities are validated local Docker IDs backed by a checked OCI/Docker archive, not remote registry digests. Promotion input changes require a new immutable build revision.

threshold_exceptions.reason: The frozen RSS formula is exceeded by 0.2194 MiB (0.0772%). Actual peak main carrier RSS differs by 72.266 MiB while Adapter differs by 1.980 MiB. Both exact retained releases completed 20 cycles with zero retained sessions or lingering owned threads and no safety services disabled. Earlier larger excesses remain retained; this exception does not prove production long-term stability.
